title: GOD THE FATHER DESCENDS IN HIS THICK DARK CLOUD — Historic Visitation in Nakuru
author: Ministry of Repentance and Holiness
excerpt: A historic supernatural visitation occurred as GOD THE FATHER Himself descended in His thick dark cloud before thousands of witnesses gathered in Nakuru, Kenya — confirming the prophetic word spoken months prior.
content:
A historic supernatural visitation occurred as GOD THE FATHER Himself descended in His thick dark cloud before thousands of witnesses gathered in Nakuru, Kenya.

This extraordinary sign confirmed the word of prophecy that had been spoken through the prophet in the weeks leading up to the gathering. Witnesses reported that a sudden, thick, dark cloud descended over the entire crusade grounds in a manner that was unlike any natural weather phenomenon.

The entire congregation fell in reverence and awe as the visible presence of GOD settled over the meeting. Many reported an overwhelming sense of holiness and the fear of the LORD that swept through the gathering.

This visitation is not the first of its kind at the Ministry of Repentance and Holiness. Over the years, the LORD has manifested His glory in visible and tangible ways — confirming that His servant is speaking His Word.

We call all people everywhere to repent and prepare for the imminent return of the Messiah, the LORD Jesus Christ. These signs are not entertainment — they are a final warning from a gracious GOD who desires that none should perish.

title: Resurrection Testimony: Mama Rosa Raised from the Dead
author: Ministry of Repentance and Holiness
excerpt: Mama Rosa was pronounced dead and her body prepared for burial. Then the power of the Holy Spirit moved through the prayer of the servant of GOD and she sat up, alive — witnessed by her family, neighbors, and medical personnel.
content:
Mama Rosa was pronounced dead. Her family had been informed. Preparations for burial had begun. Then the power of the Holy Spirit moved through the prayer of the servant of GOD.

She sat up. Alive.

This resurrection account is among the most documented miracles from the Ministry of Repentance and Holiness. Multiple witnesses — family members, neighbours, and medical personnel — have given their testimonies. Video documentation was made at the time.

Jesus Christ said: 'I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.' — John 11:25

The miracles performed through this Ministry are not to glorify any man. They are the signature of GOD upon the Word that is being preached: repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand. The Messiah is coming.

We give all glory to GOD the Father, to His Son the LORD Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Spirit — who is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

title: The Ebola Prophecy: Spoken in November 2009, Fulfilled in 2014
author: Ministry of Repentance and Holiness
excerpt: In November 2009, the LORD warned through His prophet of a great and deadly plague that would sweep through West Africa. Five years later, the Ebola crisis of 2014 confirmed every detail of the prophecy — names of nations, scale, and the suffering described in advance.
content:
In November 2009, the LORD warned through His prophet of a great and deadly plague that would sweep through West Africa. No one was talking about Ebola in 2009.

Five years later, the Ebola crisis of 2014 emerged exactly as described — the regions named, the scale of suffering, the international response — all matching the details spoken by the prophet years before.

The PDF document containing the original November 2009 prophecy is available for free download on the Documents page of this website. It carries the date stamp from when it was first published — years before the outbreak.

This is not coincidence. This is not clever prediction. This is the Word of the living GOD, who declares the end from the beginning (Isaiah 46:10).

We encourage every person reading this to download the document, verify the dates, and then ask yourself: if GOD knew about Ebola in 2009, what else does He know? And if He is warning the world today to repent and prepare for the return of His Son — will you listen?

The Messiah is coming. Repent. Prepare the way.

title: The Hour Has Come: A Call to Repentance and Holiness
author: Ministry of Repentance and Holiness
excerpt: The message of this Ministry has never changed since its founding: repent, walk in holiness, and prepare your heart for the coming King. In this teaching, we examine what the Word of GOD demands of the Church in this final hour.
content:
The message of this Ministry has never changed since its founding: repent, walk in holiness, and prepare your heart for the coming King.

The world is full of voices telling the Church that grace covers everything, that holiness is impossible, that the standard of GOD is too high. But the Word of GOD says: 'Be holy as I am holy.' (1 Peter 1:16)

Repentance is not a one-time event. It is a lifestyle. It is the daily turning away from all sin — in thought, word, and deed — and the daily choosing of GOD over the world.

The Bride of Christ must make herself ready (Revelation 19:7). The garment of holiness is not optional. It is the very thing the Bridegroom is looking for when He returns.

We encourage every believer to:

1. Examine your heart daily before GOD.
2. Confess and turn from all known sin.
3. Put on the full armour of GOD (Ephesians 6:10–18).
4. Pursue holiness in every area of life — relationships, business, speech, thoughts.
5. Keep your eyes on the return of the King.

The PDF document 'The Garment For This Hour' is available on the Documents page and goes deeper into this teaching. We encourage you to download and study it prayerfully.

title: How to Navigate the Fulfilled Prophecies Archive (150+ Videos)
author: Ministry Web Team
excerpt: The Prophecies page on this website now contains over 150 documented fulfilled prophecies with video evidence. Here is a guide to help you navigate the archive and understand what you are seeing.
content:
The Prophecies page on this website now contains over 150 documented fulfilled prophecies with video evidence. Each entry links to a YouTube video where the prophecy was spoken and, where available, news footage or testimony confirming its fulfilment.

HOW TO USE THE ARCHIVE:

The prophecies are organised into categories: Earthquakes, Floods, Wars and Conflicts, Aviation Incidents, Disease Outbreaks, Political Events, Celestial Signs, and Healings.

For each prophecy, you will find:
- The title describing the prophesied event
- The category and fulfilment status (Fulfilled or Watch)
- A link to the video evidence

WHY THIS MATTERS:

The purpose of the archive is not to impress. It is to bear witness to the fact that GOD is speaking to this generation through His servant. Each fulfilled prophecy is an invitation — a gracious call from a merciful GOD for people to turn to Him before it is too late.

If GOD knew about these events before they happened, then He is real, His Word is true, and His warning about the return of His Son must also be taken seriously.

Repent. Prepare the way.
